caption:
OpenAI has revealed first results for Jalapeño, its custom inference chip.

As AI models scale globally, the biggest hurdle isn't just model architecture—it's the power, latency, and financial cost of running inference.

Key details from OpenAI's release:
• Custom inference silicon built for modern AI models
• Higher throughput and lower latency
• Improved energy and power efficiency

Swipe through to see why custom silicon matters for the future of AI infrastructure.
